result.summary: C4 source-logit scale 0.3 produced about 0.42 mean KL, strongly negative robust/worst-continuation lower bounds and zero greedy changes across three seeds. C5 preserved source logits and raised residual cap to 12, but all three seeds still selected epoch 1, crossed zero greedy boundaries through 31 epochs and showed worsening validation scores.
result.conclusion: Do not tune only cap, epoch count, optimizer seed or learning rate, and do not globally soften saturated source logits.
result.next_step: Complete the posterior-conditioned 128x2 disagreement data and use a learned representation/objective that directly fits balanced per-action counterfactual values with independent-state, cross-seed, cross-opponent and tail-risk gates.
